verdict: The Da Nang International Marathon runs through Vietnam's central coastal hub -- historically home to Da Nang Bay (formerly Tourane Bay) and a significant regional university system (University of Da Nang, established 1994). Three distances (10K/21K/42K) with a specific, confirmed registration-opening date (8 July 2026) give runners genuine planning clarity, similar to the Bangkok Marathon's clearly announced nationwide registration date covered elsewhere in this research. sections.heading: A Marathon on Vietnam's Central Coast
paragraphs: The Da Nang International Marathon offers three distances -- 10K, 21K and the 42.195K full marathon -- in Da Nang, Vietnam. [1] Da Nang is a major coastal city in Central Vietnam, historically significant during the Vietnam War era, home to Da Nang Bay (formerly known as Tourane Bay under French colonial administration) and a substantial regional university system.

sections.heading: A Region With Deep Educational and Historical Roots
paragraphs: The University of Da Nang, established on 4 April 1994, is a major multi-disciplinary regional university system serving Central Vietnam -- giving the city genuine institutional infrastructure beyond its coastal tourism appeal. [2] Da Nang's history as a former air base and military-significant port during the Vietnam War era also gives the city a layer of historical depth for travellers interested in the region's 20th-century history.
